relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: inflammatory factors such as IL-1β and TNF-α are continuously upregulated, activating pathways such as NF-κB and MAPK, inducing the expression of MMPs and ADAMTS, and accelerating ECM degradation

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Matrix disruption further promotes the release of neurotrophic factors (such as NGF, VEGF), induces angiogenesis and nerve fiber invasion into the nucleus pulposus area

key_findings: Review: IVD degeneration inflammation (IL-1β, TNF-α) drives MMP expression and ECM degradation, with VEGF/NGF-driven angiogenesis and innervation; BDNF and CGRP mediate central remodeling.
